items.name: The weekly schedule shows each dressing room's own sauna days
items.rule: Availability is per dressing room, per weekday
items.evidence: GET /api/houses/demo/views: schedule for ph8 is Tuesday at 17:00, 18:30, 20:00, all free; ph9 has Thursday, Friday, Saturday only, no Tuesday slots.

items.name: A standing slot cannot be requested on a closed day
items.rule: Availability is per dressing room, per weekday
items.evidence: POST /api/houses/demo/bookings for apartment 12, ph9 Tuesday 17:00: HTTP 409 closed-day; exact reason: "pukuhuone 9 has no sauna day on Tuesday. It opens on Thursday, Friday, Saturday. Request pukuhuone 8 on Tuesday at 17:00 (ph8) instead." openDays Thursday, Friday, Saturday; views still empty.

items.name: A requested slot on an open day is confirmed
items.rule: A slot is confirmed against availability and held by one household
items.evidence: Booking confirmed 17:00–18:30 weekly and re-read as held by 12.

items.name: A held slot cannot be confirmed for another household
items.rule: A slot is confirmed against availability and held by one household
items.evidence: Booking confirmed 17:00–18:30 weekly and re-read as held by 12. Apartment 3 refused as held; original holder unchanged.

items.name: A second standing slot is granted while there is room
items.rule: A household may hold a second standing slot when there is room
items.evidence: POST /bookings for 12 at Tuesday 18:30 returned confirmed booking-4; GET /views re-read booking-2 and booking-4 held by 12.

items.name: A second standing slot is refused when the schedule is full
items.rule: A household may hold a second standing slot when there is room
items.evidence: POST /bookings for 12 without coordinates returned 409 full: "The weekly schedule has no free standing slot. No second standing slot can be confirmed." No alternative was suggested; GET /views retained exactly booking-2 for 12 and booking-4 for 3.

items.name: Confirming a booking updates all three derived views together
items.rule: One booking is the single source of truth for the list, the timer and the billing
items.evidence: POST demo/bookings confirmed booking-2 for apartment 12 Tuesday 17:00–18:30 in ph8. GET views showed that same booking in the posted list, heater schedule and billing signal naming payer 12. Follow-up POST give-up and GET views showed all three cleared for the same booking.

items.name: Giving up a slot leaves no derived view still claiming it
items.rule: One booking is the single source of truth for the list, the timer and the billing
items.evidence: POST demo/bookings confirmed booking-2 and GET views showed all three signals; POST booking-2/give-up succeeded. GET views showed the slot free and the posted list, heater schedule and billing signals empty.

items.name: Two households request the same free slot with neither request answered
items.rule: Two households requesting one free slot leave exactly one holder
items.evidence: GET demo/views: ph8 Tuesday 17:00 free; two socket POSTs written before reading either response. Apartment 12 confirmed, 3 refused held; GET views shows one holding, posted entry, heater entry and standing billing signal, all booking-2 for 12.

items.name: The race is run one hundred times and never confirms twice
items.rule: Two households requesting one free slot leave exactly one holder
items.evidence: 100 races, each preceded by GET confirming ph8 Tuesday 17:00 free and followed by give-up of the confirmed booking: exactly one confirmed 100, both 0, neither 0. Both socket requests were written before either response was read.

items.name: The refusal for a closed day is judged usable
items.rule: A refusal is judged by whether a resident can act on it without asking again
items.evidence: The fresh agent named a request from the refusal; HTTP confirmation follows. Answer: REQUEST: pukuhuone 8 | Tuesday | 17:00

items.name: A free release offers only the selected occurrence
items.rule: Releasing one week preserves the standing holding
items.evidence: POST booking-2/releases FREE 2026-06-02 offered occurrence-4; apartment 3 took it. Dated list and heat show 3, only 12 has standing fee; June 9 list and heat show 12.

items.name: Releasing one week does not offer a different week
items.rule: Releasing one week preserves the standing holding
items.evidence: POST FREE release for June 2 returned offered; apartment 3 take returned taken. June 9 projection retains apartment 12 and normal standing charge.

items.name: An untaken release does not cancel the holding or its normal fee
items.rule: Releasing one week preserves the standing holding
items.evidence: POST FREE release ends 2026-06-02T18:30Z; date -u -s 2026-06-02 18:31:00 succeeded, app now 18:31. Occurrence unclaimed, list household null, heat empty, standing held by 12 and fee due; next week list and heat show 12.

items.name: Taking a free occurrence charges no fee to the taker
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST FREE release and apartment 3 take: HTTP 200 taken; dated list and heater show apartment 3 on 2026-01-06; billing only standing-slot payer 12, no taker fee; 2026-01-13 shows 12, standing holding retained.

items.name: Taking a sale occurrence raises a distinct resale signal
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST SALE release and apartment 3 take: HTTP 200 taken; dated list and heater show 3; billing shows standing-slot payer 12 and resale payer 3, occurrence-4 on 2026-01-06, policy v1 and resale-fee reference; following Tuesday belongs to 12.

items.name: Withdrawing an untaken offer before its occurrence begins
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST FREE offer then holder withdraw: HTTP 200 withdrawn, dated list and heater restore 12; take by 3 refused HTTP 422 not-offered, standing fee and later Tuesday remain with 12.

items.name: An accepted transfer cannot be withdrawn by the original holder
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: POST FREE offer, apartment 3 take, then apartment 12 withdraw: HTTP 422 already-taken; dated list, heater and release remain with 3, standing fee and next Tuesday remain with 12.

items.name: An untaken offer expires when its occurrence begins
items.rule: Free and paid taking have different billing consequences
items.evidence: Set baseline 2026-01-05 12:00 UTC before startup, offer beginsAt 2026-01-06T17:00:00Z; date -u -s 2026-01-06 17:00:01 succeeded; GET views now 17:00:01Z shows unclaimed, no household or heat, holder 12 and standing fee; take returned HTTP 422 not-offered; next Tuesday held by 12.

items.name: A taken occurrence has one taker in every view
items.rule: The three derived views describe one occurrence holder
items.evidence: FREE release: 3 alone took; dated list, heat and standing-only billing checked; following Tuesday remains 12.

items.name: Two households try to take the same released occurrence
items.rule: The three derived views describe one occurrence holder
items.evidence: FREE release: 3 alone took; dated list, heat and standing-only billing checked; following Tuesday remains 12.

items.name: A free eligible slot does not put a multi-slot household under notice
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST /scarcity/evaluate A with a third free slot and 3 waiting returned full=false, notices=[]; GET /views retained both 12 holdings without notices.

items.name: An empty queue does not put a multi-slot household under notice
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST /scarcity/evaluate A with both slots held by 12 and empty queue returned notices=[]; GET /views confirmed no notices.

items.name: A released occurrence is not a free standing slot
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST FREE release for booking-2 on 2026-11-24 returned offered with no taker. POST /scarcity/evaluate A returned full=true, waiting=true and one active notice offered to queue-head 4. GET dated views showed held standing slot, unclaimed occurrence with no heat, standing fee paid by 12 and next week list and heat restored for 12.

items.name: Waiting in another resource group does not trigger notice here
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST /queue for 4 in B then /scarcity/evaluate A returned no notices; GET /views showed both A slots held by 12, B-only queue, and no notice.

items.name: The queue is ordered by accepted request within its eligible group
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST /queue A accepted 4 as sequence 6 then 5 as sequence 8; GET /views showed only A entries, and POST /scarcity/evaluate A offered the notice to 4 (queue-6).

items.name: One multi-holding household receives only one active notice
items.rule: Scarcity requires both full capacity and a waiting household
items.evidence: POST /scarcity/evaluate A twice after three holdings for 12 and queue 4 returned the same active notice-10, selectedBookingId null; GET /views showed one active notice and all three holdings.

items.name: The holder chooses before the choose deadline
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST notice choose selected booking-2; GET views before deadlines showed booking-2 and booking-4 still held by 12, with only booking-2 selected for lapse on the recorded notice deadline.

items.name: The choice right passes after the shorter clock
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: After date -u -s advanced past recorded choose deadline, GET views reported now past it, chooseRight queue-head offered to 3, and both holdings still held by 12.

items.name: Passing the choose deadline does not pass the loss deadline
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: After advancing past recorded choose deadline GET views reported unchanged later noticeDeadline and both holdings still held by 12.

items.name: Lapse changes only the selected standing holding
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: After selecting booking-2 and advancing beyond notice deadline, GET views showed booking-2 lapsed, booking-4 held by 12, and posted list and standing billing contained only booking-4.

items.name: A confirmed queue claim takes effect only at lapse
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST claim confirm returned pending successor 3; GET views before notice deadline identified successor 3 while both bookings and the posted list remained held by 12.

items.name: A queue-head decline offers the holding to the next eligible entry
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST claim decline by 3 returned offeredTo 4; GET views showed 4 offered the selected claim and booking-2 still held and posted for 12 before lapse.

items.name: If all claimants decline, the selected holding returns to the pool at lapse
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST claims declined by 3 and 4, then advanced clock past noticeDeadline. GET views showed booking-2 lapsed and its slot free, while booking-4 remained held by 12.

items.name: A pending notice retains its original deadlines after the queue empties
items.rule: Choosing and losing a holding are different events
items.evidence: POST queue withdrawal, GET views showed active notice retaining chooseDeadline, noticeDeadline and policy v1. After advancing past the noticeDeadline, GET views showed selected booking-2 lapsed and its slot free.

items.name: Different houses can open different resources and days
items.rule: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles
items.evidence: GET /api/houses/demo/views shows three free Tuesday ph8 windows; GET /api/houses/masthugget/views shows Saturday, Sunday and Friday windows, none Tuesday.

items.name: Booker standing is checked within the household's house
items.rule: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles
items.evidence: GET house policies shows demo resident and soukanvuori shareholder roles. POST Tuesday ph8 17:00 confirms resident in demo and shareholder with manager actor in soukanvuori. Cross-role requests at 18:30 are refused booker-role in both houses; GET views retains each confirmed holding.

items.name: A manager-mediated house does not expose a resident self-service queue
items.rule: A house owns its calendars and eligible booker roles
items.evidence: GET soukanvuori/views shows manager-mediated, operator manager, queueAvailable false; demo/views shows self-service, queueAvailable true. Resident queue POST in soukanvuori refused operator-required and directs to manager; demo queue POST returns queued.

items.name: A rule change records its authority and effective date
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: Recorded board authority and future v2; before effective booking v1, after clock boundary v2.

items.name: A dispute can reconstruct one booking's decision
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: Manager dispute evidence includes booking, confirmation and give-up history with policy versions.

items.name: A policy revision does not rewrite an earlier refusal
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: Closed-day refusal retained its original reason and policy version after board revision.

items.name: A notice keeps the policy version that created its deadlines
items.rule: Policy revisions and disputes preserve their evidence
items.evidence: Existing notice retained 14/30-day instants; later notice under effective v2 used revised clocks.

items.name: A household with one family-time booking cannot take another
items.rule: A cap counts only bookings in its configured class
items.evidence: POST June 6 10:00 confirmed booking-2; POST 11:30 returned 409 class-cap with family-time cap 1 and existing booking-2 identified.

items.name: An unrelated class does not consume the family-time allowance
items.rule: A cap counts only bookings in its configured class
items.evidence: POST ordinary June 5 17:00 confirmed booking-2; POST family June 6 10:00 confirmed booking-4; reread lists both.

items.name: Family-time allowance does not block a different class
items.rule: A cap counts only bookings in its configured class
items.evidence: POST family June 6 10:00 confirmed booking-2; POST ordinary June 5 17:00 confirmed booking-4; reread lists both.

items.name: A house without the family-time cap does not inherit it
items.rule: A cap counts only bookings in its configured class
items.evidence: GET masthugget policy cap 1; POST house-b with no class cap; POST family 10:00 and 11:30 both confirmed for same eligible tenant, persisted in house-b view.

items.name: A completed family-time occurrence no longer uses the allowance
items.rule: A cap counts only bookings in its configured class
items.evidence: POST family booking ends 2026-06-06T11:30Z; date -u -s 2026-06-06 11:31:00 succeeded and app now 11:31; POST 13:00 family confirmed booking-4.
